name: Cottonwood Model Portfolios -- 3rd Partner Cohort + Firm-Scoped View
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-07. Add a Cottonwood dropdown view on the Model Portfolios page (matching the existing Global/49F/Inflection pattern). Cottonwood was explicitly named as the next partner cohort when MDPF_ASSETS built the canonical Cohort taxonomy (Cohort 1=49F/SmartX, Cohort 2=Inflection/Eclipse-Orion, Cohort 0=ETF public residual) but was never built -- this project is Cohort 3. KEY FINDING (source-grounded): Black Diamond's already-live REST access for Cottonwood (data/cot/scripts/bronze/cot_bronze_ingest.py, .bd.identity cookie flow, DATA_PLATFORM_D2-documented) already queries a 'Portfolio Strategy ID'/'Portfolio Strategy Name' dimension on the transactions/realized/unrealized tables -- likely already flowing into opal-data-cot silver, unused. This narrows Andrew's proposed CUSIP-transaction-scan discovery method to a cheap populated-field verification rather than a fresh investigation. Structure follows the WS-C (Inflection) pattern: partner-side gold tagging (a cot-side model_portfolio_accounts-equivalent artifact) + MDPF aggregator read, not a standalone MDPF feeder. Frontend: ModelPortfolios.tsx hardcodes a binary 49F/Inflection branch keyed on claims.firmId (JWT) -- needs a real 3rd 'cottonwood' branch + a cottonwoodmail-domain to firmId:'cottonwood' claim mapping (mechanism TBD, Phase 0). PRD docs/architecture/MDPF_COTMDL_PRD.md.
